acceptedTermsVersion.description: Version of the terms the player accepted

needsTermsAcceptance.description: The terms changed (or were never accepted): ask the player to accept them

id.description: Stable key, mapped to i18n by the app

answer.description: The chosen option id, or every option id in order for chronology questions

result.description: Set once the session is over

newUser.description: True when this request created the account (e.g. first social sign-in)

active.description: False when the card was removed from the catalog file; owned copies stay valid

version.description: Content hash of the seeded catalog file, also sent as the ETag

distinctCards.description: Distinct catalog cards owned, any finish

nextAt.description: When the next craft is earned; null when the stock is full

cardIds.description: 3 distinct cards owned by the player

isNew.description: The player owned no copy of this card before

isNewFinish.description: The player owned no copy of this card in this finish before

slot.description: 1-based slot, 5 is the guaranteed rare-or-better slot

nextDomain.description: Domain of the next round, null once the duel is over

capped.description: True when the daily cap of rewarded duel wins was already reached

value.description: same|different, an era, a stat, or a round number as text

guaranteedSlotOnly.description: Only the guaranteed slot (5) can roll this finish

minRarity.description: Minimum rarity eligible for this finish

nextAt.description: Server time of the next free booster; null when the stock is full

sceaux.description: Price in Sceaux, null while the premium currency isn't available

activeToday.description: The friend kept their streak today (their local day); false for requests

nudgedToday.description: I already nudged this friend today (my local day)

current.description: Shared streak as of today (0 when broken)

friendDoneToday.description: The friend kept theirs today (their local day)

meDoneToday.description: I kept my streak today (my local day)

incoming.description: Requests other players sent to me

outgoing.description: Requests I sent, not answered yet

dailyResetAt.description: Start of the player's next local day, when daily caps reset

sections.description: Sections added by other domains (progression, packs...), keyed by MeContributor#key

freezes.description: Streak freezes added to the inventory

reached.description: Already reached (rewards are granted once per lifetime)

templateId.description: Stable template key, mapped to i18n by the app

nicknameChangeAvailableAt.description: Next time the nickname can be changed; null = now

NewPlayerGuaranteesDto.description: Extra guarantees for a new player's first boosters, on top of the regular odds and pity

firstPackBestFinishAtLeast.description: Minimum finish of the first booster's best card

firstPackDistinctContinents.description: Distinct continents among the first booster's cards

firstPackMinDistinctEras.description: Minimum distinct eras among the first booster's cards

firstPackSlots.description: Composition of the very first booster, in slot order (slot 5 holds the best card)

legendaryWithinFirstPacks.description: A legendary or better is guaranteed within the player's first N boosters

remainingToday.description: Nudges I can still send today

continentFallback.description: Themed booster: a rarity without any card of the continent is drawn from the whole season

influenceGained.description: Influence granted for duplicates in this booster

cardId.description: Card shown with the option, when it is a figure

id.description: Value to send back: a card id, or an ISO country code

epicGuaranteedIn.description: Boosters left until an epic or better is guaranteed (1 = the next one)

newPlayerLegendaryIn.description: New-player guarantee: boosters left until a legendary or better is guaranteed (1 = the next one); null once the player pulled one or opened enough boosters

collectionPercent.description: Distinct cards owned / cards in the season, 0–100

currentStreak.description: Streak as of today (0 when broken)

freezeAvailable.description: At least one streak freeze is in stock

freezes.description: Streak freezes in stock (max 2), this week's free one included

streakActiveToday.description: A streak activity was already done today

xpForNextLevel.description: XP needed for the next level, null at max level

xpIntoLevel.description: XP earned since the current level was reached

text.description: Extra text, e.g. a bio with the name masked

bonusPack.description: True when this quiz earned a bonus booster (every 5 perfect quizzes)

rewardCapped.description: True when the daily reward cap was already reached: no Influence nor booster progress

quantity.description: Copies to recycle; at least one copy of this finish is always kept

locale.description: App language, used for the notification texts (fr or en)

acceptTerms.description: The player accepted the current terms of use and privacy policy

ageConfirmed.description: The player confirmed meeting the minimum age (GET /api/v1/legal)

expiresAt.description: End of the repair window (player's midnight)

usedThisMonth.description: This month's repair is already used

tieRule.description: How a tie on values was settled; null when values differ

acceptTerms.description: True when the player accepted the current terms and confirmed the minimum age on this screen

authorizationCode.description: Apple only: one-time authorization code, used to revoke the authorization when the account is deleted

nickname.description: Wished nickname for a new account

nonce.description: Raw nonce used for this sign-in, if any

activeToday.description: A streak activity was already done today

current.description: Streak as of today (0 when broken)

dayEndsAt.description: Next local midnight: today's activity must happen before it

freezes.description: Streak freezes in stock (this week's free one included)

quantityTo.description: Holo copies owned after the upgrade

remainingFrom.description: Standard copies left (the upgraded copy is removed from them)
